commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: Backbiters see the faults of strangers. If they could see their own fault of backbiting in the same way, could any suffering come to the lasting soul? Standing fair and seeing both alike is hard, hence “could”. Once seen, the fault stops, so there is no sin and no suffering in births to come.
